response.sql: WITH item_town AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town_city) SELECT town_city, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town) AS ratio_excess FROM town WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town)

assumptions.assumption: The cross-town average is the plain average of the per-town average ratios (each town weighted equally), as the request says 'average of that ratio across all towns'.
Rows where derived_total_cost is 0 are treated as missing ratios (NULLIF) to avoid division errors; NULL ratios/prices are ignored by AVG.
order_item_id is taken from Invoice_Line_Items, and the per-item grouping is by order_item_id and town only.
